labels.rationale: Upstream werkzeug safe_join rejected absolute paths only through os.path.isabs, which on the ntpath rules of Python versions before 3.11 does not treat a leading forward slash as absolute, so a join argument beginning with `/` survived normalization and escaped the intended directory. Fixed upstream in werkzeug 3.0.6 by also rejecting a filename that starts with a forward slash (CVE-2024-49766). Provenance: upstream diff src/werkzeug/security.py 3.0.5 -> 3.0.6.

Upstream werkzeug multipart decoding wrote each incoming data event for a non-file field into an accumulating container without tracking the total size of that field, so a field delivered as many small data events bypassed max_form_memory_size, which was only enforced per event inside the decoder. Fixed upstream in werkzeug 3.0.6 by accumulating field_size across data events and raising RequestEntityTooLarge (CVE-2024-49767). Provenance: upstream diff src/werkzeug/formparser.py 3.0.5 -> 3.0.6.
